workflows.name: research-setup
workflows.description: Initialize a project with the durable Research OS workspace contract.

workflows.name: research-1-grill
workflows.description: Interrogate a research idea one decision at a time until it is researchable.

workflows.name: research-2-brief
workflows.description: Collapse the current discussion and evidence into a rigorous research brief.

workflows.name: research-3-falsify
workflows.description: Predeclare what evidence would kill the current research design before any expensive work begins.

workflows.name: research-4-tasks
workflows.description: Split a research brief into dependency-aware tracer workpackages.

workflows.name: research-5-run
workflows.description: Claim and execute one eligible research workpackage with bounded authority, falsification gates, receipts, and readback.

workflows.name: research-6-review
workflows.description: Attack the current research design or draft as a skeptical journal panel and record every finding.

workflows.name: research-save
workflows.description: Create a verifiable handoff that preserves research continuity across sessions.

workflows.name: to-plan
workflows.description: Convert a verified Research Brief into an executable academic research plan.

workflows.name: to-proposal
workflows.description: Turn a research design into a grant, institutional, or project proposal.

workflows.name: to-paper
workflows.description: Draft an academic paper from verified research artifacts.
